newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan provincial governor James Soong insists on finishing his current term.
Stock market plunges as foreign funds dump shares.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Cambodia accuses Taiwan of interfering with its internal affairs, orders Taiwan representative office closed.
High-level authorities plan to approve (provincial governor) James Soong's pending resignation.
LIBERTY TIMES - Cambodia orders Taiwan office to close.
President Lee Teng-hui says constitutional reforms have nothing to do with promoting Taiwan independence.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Foreign funds sell T$7 billion in Taiwan stocks.
Orders for Taiwan's electronics, information and telecommunication products account for more than 40 percent of Taiwan's total exports to the United States.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Yangming Marine plans to expand operations in mainland China.
Taiwan, Hong Kong reach consensus on WTO talks.
